Four is fine. What is being cut, though? If the method goes, the whole thing becomes a story about us.
The feedback was that the reader is told what was done, but not why it was done.
That is fair. The rationale is in my head, not on the page. It can be added without making the document longer.

May I ask what each of them is reviewing? Four reviewers with no scope is how a document gets edited until nobody can tell who wrote it.
Two for content, two for language. Does that work?
It does. My name is on it, so I would like the final version to be approved by me before it goes out.

Good morning. I have been asked to explain how the program was built, because four other countries are going to copy it and everybody wants the short version. It was designed in Brazil, by a team of three people, and it was never meant to travel. The first version was tested in two sites for six months. The findings were not what we expected: the problem was not the training, it was that nothing was ever standardized, so every manager was doing something different. Once the process was streamlined and the framework was written down, the results were replicated in the other sites without any of us being there. The case study was published last year, and since then it has been adopted by three regions. Nothing in it is complicated. It was simply written down properly, once.

Adriana, it is Daniel from the global team. Your case study has been selected for the internal conference in October, which is good news and also a deadline. Two things are needed from you. The document has to be cut to four pages, and the rationale for each decision has to be made explicit, because right now the reader is told what was done but not why it was done. Second, the presentation is fifteen minutes and it will be given in English, with questions afterwards. Those questions are the real event, so do not spend your preparation on the slides. One more thing: your name is on it, so do not let the document be edited by four people until nobody can tell who wrote it.
